name: GameVault
description: GameVault 17.0.1 is a self-hosted library for DRM-free games, with a web UI and PostgreSQL.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Db password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  gamevault:
    image: phalcode/gamevault-backend:17.0.1@sha256:f3c599d4fc7498eb2028cfd611dc27b3f707c83a7ce9a86ec3ec8256a42409ba
    container_name: gamevault
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      gamevault-db:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:8080"
    environment:
      DB_HOST: gamevault-db
      DB_USERNAME: gamevault
      DB_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_DB_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/files:/files
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/media:/media
  gamevault-db:
    image: postgres:18.6@sha256:5a5a84b19854a9ffaa54082c166ff4ec27473a361e496e5ea167f298f2da9722
    container_name: gamevault-db
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: gamevault
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_DB_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: gamevault
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/database:/var/lib/postgresql
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U gamevault -d gamevault"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
notes: Open http://localhost:20032. Put DRM-free game files in the gamevault_files volume, which is mounted at /files. Media is stored at /media. Host port 8080 is already used by other apps, so this listing publishes 20032. Keep DB_PASSWORD and POSTGRES_PASSWORD the same.
